title: Hammers of mayhem
description:
This resource pack retextures the Netherite and Diamond Pickaxes and also includes an occasional special custom Netherite Axe texture for extra flair.

⚠️ Compatibility Notice
Fully compatible with Sodium, but Minecraft will display a warning..
body:
This pack adds retextures for the netherite axe and pickaxe but also currently includes diamond pickaxe only and will get other sets of tools in the future
This pack works with optifine and fabric but if u want to run it on fabric u need the following mods
[Cit resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)

[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
